description.text: One of the two expansions released on 27 October 2023, together with Ancient Roar, built around the Future Paradox Pokémon, whose cards carry a Future mark and a specially designed right half. Iron Valiant ex and Iron Hands ex lead it, with Iron Moth, Iron Bundle, Iron Jugulis, Future Booster Energy Capsule, Techno Radar and the Supporter Professor Turo's Scenario. Aegislash ex, Altaria ex, Maushold ex and the Tera Pokémon Toxtricity ex join them, and the gym leader Tulip appears as a Supporter for the first time. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 66, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and gold Ultra Rare Iron Valiant ex, Counter Catcher and basic Metal Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Paradox Rift in November 2023.
